title: Five-sided heating and two-zone control in a box-type resistance furnace
summary: Five-sided heating describes where heating elements are installed; two-zone control describes which elements share temperature regulation. The counts are not interchangeable. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s high-temperature box-furnace proposal dated 14 September 2020 places elements on both side walls, the rear wall, door and hearth, divided into front and rear control zones. For similar metal-part heating, map loading to those zones before checking measurement and verification. Five heating faces do not mean five independent temperature zones.
